segment_rules._description: SG2 and SG12 are both triggered by NAD, and the hierarchy builder opens a top-level SG2 for the SG12 NAD+VY rather than nesting it — so a group-scoped DE 3035 restriction on SG2 fires on a party the AHB puts in SG12. The constraint is expressed on the flat NAD rule instead: MS and MR stay required, and VY is admitted. Tracked in ROADMAP.md.

group_rules._description: SG12 NAD+VY Muss — Altlieferant. Bedingung [518]: „Es sind alle Altlieferanten anzugeben, an die eine Abmeldeanfrage gesendet wird"; [566] „Altlieferant".

group_rules._description: SG12 NAD+VY is Muss [206] „Wenn SG4 STS+7++ZG5 … nicht vorhanden" — a negated condition the Bedingungsoperatoren cannot express, so presence is not enforced here and the qualifier is. The positive obligation lives in the workflow, which knows the Aufhebungsgrund. [579]: auslösender Marktpartner — LFN bei ZH0/ZG9, NB bei ZH1.
